summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Andrzej Sławiński, a Polish economist. It gives his birth date and place, his academic position at the Warsaw School of Economics, his membership on the Council of Monetary Policies since 2004, and his fellowship at Collegium Invisibile.
one_line: Polish economist and Warsaw School of Economics professor who has served on the Council of Monetary Policies since 2004.
key_facts: Andrzej Sławiński was born on July 31, 1951, in Warsaw.
Andrzej Sławiński is a Polish economist.
Andrzej Sławiński is a Professor of Economics at the Warsaw School of Economics.
Andrzej Sławiński has been a member of the Council of Monetary Policies since 2004.
Andrzej Sławiński is a fellow of Collegium Invisibile.
